intro: Gloryville Ministries International is a Spirit-inspired ministry with a mandate to raise an end-time army.

pastorQuote.text: The Word always works. If you stand on the Word of God, it will work for you.

story.opening: Gloryville Ministries International began as a regular meeting of a few people, led by Pastor Samuel Bodunde.
paragraphs: Those meetings were non-denominational: people simply came together to fellowship with God. In time they grew into the Glory Conferences, held in different places across South-West Nigeria.
Alongside the conferences came Times of Refreshing, a Saturday gathering much like a Sunday service, held in a home at UI (the University of Ibadan).
The church then began fully as Gloryville Christian Centre, meeting on Sundays and Wednesdays, and for a season holding a weekly vigil on Fridays.
The name later changed to Gloryville Ministries International, to make room for the broader vision of the ministry and the mandate God gave the set man, Pastor Samuel Bodunde.

vision.text: To see believers reigning in all areas of life, doing exploits in the faith.
vision.verse: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.

mission.text: To preach the gospel of Jesus Christ so men may be saved.
To teach believers to enjoy and walk in their inheritance.
To train believers to be witnesses of Jesus Christ in all the world.

aims.text: To see a move of the Spirit in the church, bringing believers massive personal victories and empowerment for the work of the ministry.
To see neighbourhoods, communities and nations wholly turned to God by the preaching of the gospel of power.
